# rustinion_aws_security_account (Resource)

Connects an AWS account so Rustinion reads its CloudTrail management events and GuardDuty findings through a read-only cross-account role. Rustinion makes up an external id (`external_id`); create the role in the account with that external id as the trust condition, for example with an `aws_iam_role` that uses this resource's `external_id`, then the role is assumed every five minutes.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) The 12-digit AWS account id.
- `device_id` (String) The enrolled device the CloudTrail log lines are stored on (its group's detection rules run over them).
- `name` (String) A name for the account (up to 80 characters).

### Optional

- `cloudtrail` (Boolean) Read CloudTrail management events. Default true.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Poll the account. Default true.
- `guardduty` (Boolean) Read GuardDuty findings. Default true.
- `regions` (List of String) Regions to read (up to 8). Default `["us-east-1"]`.
- `role_name` (String) Name of the IAM role Rustinion assumes in the account. Default `RustinionSecurityRead`.

### Read-Only

- `external_id` (String) The external id the role's trust policy must require (`sts:ExternalId`).
- `id` (String) The account's id in Rustinion.
- `role_arn` (String) ARN of the role Rustinion assumes.
